integrity.proof_type: self-contained elementary rational perturbation and exhaustive clique-type analysis

scientific_limitations: The result proves a uniform additive lower bound on the optimal clique relaxation, not its exact optimum.
The scope is five-symbol multiset one-deletion coding for all input sizes n >= 8.
The exact integer independence number is borrowed from the July 2026 prior theorem, not claimed as new.
The argument does not establish a multiplicative gap bounded away from one.
title: A uniform maximal-clique relaxation gap in five-symbol multiset deletion coding
